aspect: Nobody in the chain does anything wrong
description: Each step is defensible in isolation. The harm exists only at the level of the whole process, and no role in the organisation is responsible for the whole process.
energy_note: A harm with no author anywhere in the building.

aspect: The burden of proof runs the wrong way
description: The claimant proves eligibility repeatedly; the institution never proves ineligibility. An error by the institution is remedied on the claimant's time and at the claimant's expense.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the counter clerk who could
description: 'I can see the letter on my screen. But I can't accept a screenshot, I need the original.' The original was sent to an address the department corrected last month. 'Then you'll need to request a duplicate.' That takes six weeks. 'Next, please.' She could have printed it. She is not required to.
energy_note: Six weeks, because she did not feel like printing it.

description: A process onerous enough causes a predictable proportion to stop claiming, which is cheaper than refusing them, and appears in the statistics as reduced demand.
energy_note: Designed so that a percentage give up, and they do.
notes: Same mechanism as ADM-004 in assets/text/general.
